title: Gloomgrave
description:
Gloomgrave is a roguelike turn-based dungeon crawler where you will explore, loot, and fight your way through the ever-shifting dungeon to defeat the evil that lies below.

Features• Loot everything:  weapons, armor, wands, rings, potions, scrolls, and more. Every piece of gear can roll blessed, enchanted, or worse...

• Procedurally generated dungeons feature hand-crafted rooms and vaults woven into randomized floors so that every run feels fresh

• Magical glyphs: discover weapons that poison, burn, or paralyze your foes, and armor that punishes those who dare strike you

• Classic turn-based combat: the dungeon only moves when you do. Take your time, plan your moves, and outsmart every encounter
